eval.description: Anthropic internal life-sciences eval of help with molecular-biology bench protocols, with web search. Two modules: Troubleshooting (detect and fix protocol errors) and Understanding (extend an online protocol; Understanding set associated with Benchling). Cards report percent scores per module. Later cards also use this suite in CB-1 automated evals in place of saturated long-form virology tasks.
eval.summary: Measures how well the model helps with molecular-biology lab protocols, including finding errors and extending them.

versions.changes: Troubleshooting and Understanding modules; Understanding V2 is a held-out Benchling set in later cards.

scores.description: The attempt is graded correct for that Protocols module item.

metrics.description: Share correct on Troubleshooting or Understanding (cards report modules separately).
